name: share
description: Represents sharing or broadcasting outward. On hover the mark winds up, data packets fire along both arms, and impact ripples blast from the receiving nodes.

provenance.notes: Base share path picked from a third-party icon site by the maintainer and animated via Gemini; exact source site unconfirmed (1024x1024 grid and node-arm geometry suggest Ant Design Icons share-alt, MIT — UNVERIFIED, confirm before use). License status: pending human review — confirm the source site before promoting to stable. Documented intentional 1024x1024 viewBox deviation to preserve the contributed geometry exactly.

animation.description: The mark winds up (rotate -12deg, squash 0.92) then releases as two data packets fire from the source node along the arms (440 units, 0.25s easeIn) while a ripple charges inward at the source; impact ripples blast outward (r 60-240) from both receiving nodes on arrival (0.5s easeOut). One-shot, ends at rest. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: Provide context for what is being shared when used in a button.
